Thanks for looping me in. A few quick notes from the marketplace/listing side before the call:

- Marketplace readiness: we need the following items ahead of a listing review: product description (50–150 words), verified support SLA, basic security questionnaire answers, and a partner contact for co-sell onboarding.
- Co-sell qualification: GCP will typically look for an MCP/partner endorsement and a preliminary ARR projection. If HelixCare can provide a projected 12-month ARR and two reference accounts, that short-circuits qualification.
- Region: confirm whether HelixCare wants the initial co-sell push in us-central (preferred) or us-west. That affects our regional PM alignment.

I’m attaching the internal listing checklist we use. On the call I’ll walk through the pieces we can take ownership of (listing copy, technical integration points) vs items HelixCare should prepare.

Karthik Iyer
GCP Partnerships | Redwood Inference

Attachments: gcp-listing-checklist.xlsx

- Week 0 (this week): Intake & qualification
  - HelixCare to fill the co-sell intake form here: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSeGcpCoSellIntake (Sarah)

- Week 1: Technical prework
  - Karthik & Redwood Solutions to review listing checklist and confirm technical integration tasks (Karthik)
  - Redwood CS to arrange a demo environment for HelixCare (Laura)

- Weeks 2–6: MAP execution (nurture)
  - Joint webinar with GCP for target accounts (Vanessa lead)
  - Co-marketing assets & marketplace listing copy (Dylan + HelixCare)
  - Weekly 30m sync to track MAP progress (owners: Dylan/HelixCare)

- Escalation path: If MAP milestones slip >1 week, escalate to regional PM (Anna) and Redwood Partnerships (Karthik).

Attachments: MAP-template.docx (Redwood MAP starter)

Next steps: Sarah, please submit the intake form and attach the ARR estimate by EOD Mon 9/22. I’ll open the HubSpot opp and share the link in the thread.
